user.title: Oil tank
user.description: Set the tank size, the outdoor temperature sensor used to estimate consumption, and the supplier's price feed.

data_description.capacity_l: Total tank size in liters. Can be changed later.
data_description.temperature_entity: An outdoor temperature sensor. Used to estimate how much oil is burned each day.
data_description.feed_url: The supplier's daily price feed. Keep the default unless the supplier changes it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the price feed. Check the URL and your internet connection.
error.invalid_feed: The price feed answered, but its content is not in the expected format.

log_fill.name: Log fill-up
log_fill.description: Record an oil delivery and update the level estimate.

price.name: Price
price.description: Total paid for the delivery in DKK.

level_after_liters.name: Level after delivery
level_after_liters.description: Liters in the tank after the delivery, if known. Used as a calibration point.

init.title: Oil tank settings
init.description: Saving reloads the integration. Your readings and fill history are kept.

data.annual_consumption_l: Yearly consumption (until enough deliveries are logged)
data.base_load_share: Share of oil not used for space heating

data_description.annual_consumption_l: Used only until about a year of deliveries (at least 3) is logged; after that the yearly consumption is measured from your deliveries.
data_description.base_load_share: Hot water and other use that does not depend on the weather, as a fraction (0.2 = 20%).
data_description.base_temp_c: Outdoor temperature above which the house needs no heating.
data_description.lead_days: Calendar days from ordering until the oil arrives.
data_description.buffer_days: Days of oil that should still be left when the delivery arrives.
data_description.min_order_l: A good price only triggers advice when the tank has room for at least this much.
data_description.window_days: How long before the order-by date to start looking for a good price.
data_description.lookback_days: Today's price is compared with the average of this many days.
data_description.calibration_enabled: Adjust the burn rate a little each time a needle reading differs from the estimate.
data_description.gauge_offset_l: What your physical gauge shows when the tank is empty. The panel subtracts it: real liters = gauge reading - offset.
data_description.gauge_scale_max: The value printed at the end of your gauge's scale. The panel dial is drawn to match it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the price feed. Check the URL and your internet connection.
error.invalid_feed: The price feed answered, but its content is not in the expected format.
